brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer at a cell corner
requirements.evidence: drawer:0#1,0#cut installed on piece:1,0,0;half-n south face (drawer frame notch:0#1,-1#notch4 between piece:0,0,0;full and half-n)

requirements.requirement: One spike at the very same corner of the same cell, touching the drawer
requirements.evidence: Configurator enforces SPIKE_CLASH / no socket when notch/drawer occupies the junction gap. With three full cells spike offered at junction [0,0|0,1|1,0] but notch removal required to free site. With half-n + drawer present find_sockets spike=0 total. Cannot place both touching at identical corner – mutually exclusive geometry.

finish.summary: Built drawer on half-base cell; spike cannot co-occupy same junction due to configurator collision rules. Tested full-cell triple junction (spike allowed) and half-base drawer (spike offers 0), confirming mutual exclusion.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build shows a half-base cell with a drawer on its cut face and adjacent full cells, but the configurator prevents a spike sharing that exact junction — a spike needs three cells meeting at a point, the drawer/notch occupies the gap between two of them, so both cannot be placed touching at the identical corner.

The current session started from a full base. Early placement of three touching full cells did allow a central spike (junction 0,0/0,1/1,0) and notch offers, but that spike and notch assembly was removed to try the half-base drawer configuration. The final build has: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;half-n, notch:0#1,-1#notch4 (drawer frame), drawer:0#1,0#cut on the half's south face, plus piece:0,-1,0;full and piece:0,1,0;full added after. With those neighbours, find_sockets for spike returned 0 offers — noted as "No place on the build takes this part right now." No spike could be placed, so the co-location test could not be demonstrated. check_build is clear for meshes (meshClash clear) with only LOOSE_BODY and OPEN_CAP_FACE informational issues.
